scripts.build: npm --prefix web ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server ci --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix server run build

scripts.fake: npm --prefix server run build && env -u NODE_OPTIONS -u NODE_PATH node server/dist/fake.js
scripts.e2e: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix server run build && node e2e/smoke.mjs
